docs.text:
pip install pulsing

​选择​后​端​：

​后​端​ ​安装​ ​适用​场景​ Transformers pip install torch transformers ​快速​测试​，CPU vLLM pip install vllm ​生产​环境​，GPU

docs.title: 步骤​ 1：​启动​ Router
docs.text:
​打开​终端​ A：

pulsing actor pulsing.serving.Router \
  --addr 0.0.0.0:8000 \
  --name my-llm \
  -- \
  --http_port 8080 \
  --model_name gpt2 \
  --worker_name worker
​参数​ ​说明​ --addr、--name（-- ​前​） Actor ​系统​地址​、Router ​名称​ --http_port、--model_name、--worker_name（-- ​后​） Router ​构造​参数​：HTTP ​端口​、API ​模型​名​、​目标​ worker ​名

docs.title: 步骤​ 2：​启动​ Worker
docs.text:
​打开​终端​ B：

Transformers (CPU)vLLM (GPU) 
pulsing actor pulsing.serving.TransformersWorker \
  --addr 0.0.0.0:8001 \
  --seeds 127.0.0.1:8000 \
  --name worker \
  -- \
  --model_name gpt2

pulsing actor pulsing.serving.VllmWorker \
  --addr 0.0.0.0:8002 \
  --seeds 127.0.0.1:8000 \
  --name worker \
  -- \
  --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B
​参数​ ​说明​ --addr、--seeds（-- ​前​） actor ​级​：​绑定​地址​、​种子​节点​ --model / --model_name（-- ​后​） ​构造​参数​：​模型​名称​/​路径

docs.title: 步骤​ 3：​验证​集群
docs.text:
# ​列出​ actor
pulsing inspect actors --endpoint 127.0.0.1:8000

# ​检查​集群​状态​
pulsing inspect cluster --seeds 127.0.0.1:8000

​你​应该​能​看到​ router ​和​ worker actor。

docs.title: 非​流式
docs.text:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt2", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}], "stream": false}'

docs.title: 流式​ (SSE)
docs.text:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt2", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "​讲个​笑话​"}], "stream": true}'

docs.title: 扩展
docs.text:
​添加​更​多​ Worker ​处理​更大​负载​：

# ​终端​ C
pulsing actor pulsing.serving.TransformersWorker --addr 0.0.0.0:8003 --seeds 127.0.0.1:8000 -- --model_name gpt2

# ​终端​ D
pulsing actor pulsing.serving.TransformersWorker --addr 0.0.0.0:8004 --seeds 127.0.0.1:8000 -- --model_name gpt2

Router ​会​自动​在​所有​ Worker ​间​负载​均衡​。

docs.title: 故障​排查
docs.text: 问题​ ​解决方案​ No available workers Router ​默认​按​名字​ worker ​查找​。​需​ (1) Worker ​用​ --name worker（​在​ -- ​前​）​启动​，​或​ (2) Router ​用​ --worker_name <​名字​>（​在​ -- ​后​）​与​ Worker ​一致​；(3) Worker ​必须​ --seeds <router_addr>。​可​执行​ pulsing inspect actors --seeds 127.0.0.1:8000 ​确认​是否​有​名为​ worker ​的​ actor。 ​连接​被​拒绝​ ​检查​ Router ​是否​以​ --addr ​启动​ ​启动​慢​ ​首次​请求​需要​加载​模型​权重

docs.title: 教程​：Ray + Pulsing
docs.text: ​用​ Pulsing ​作为​ Ray Actor ​的​通信​骨干​——​增加​流式​、Actor ​发现​和​跨​集群​调用​能力​，​无需​替换​ Ray。

docs.title: 两种​使用​方式
docs.text:
1. ​桥接​模式​ — ​保留​ Ray Actor，​通过​ pul.mount() ​接入​ Pulsing ​通信​
  2. ​独立​模式​ — ​直接​使用​ Pulsing ​原生​ API（​适合​新​项目​或​完全​迁移​）

docs.title: 桥接​模式​：​为​ Ray Actor ​增加​ Pulsing ​通信
docs.text:
​最​简单​的​路径​——Ray ​负责​调度​，Pulsing ​负责​通信​：

import ray
import pulsing as pul

@ray.remote
class Worker:
    def __init__(self, name):
        pul.mount(self, name=name)  # ​一行​代码​：​接入​ Pulsing ​网络​

    async def call_peer(self, peer_name, msg):
        proxy = await pul.resolve(peer_name, timeout=30)
        return await proxy.greet(msg)  # ​跨​进程​ Pulsing ​调用​

    async def greet(self, msg):
        return f"hello: {msg}"

ray.init()
workers = [Worker.remote(f"w{i}") for i in range(3)]
ray.get(workers[0].call_peer.remote("w1", "hi"))  # => "hello: hi"
pul.cleanup_ray()

​你​获得​的​能力​： Ray ​处理​进程​调度​和​资源管理​。Pulsing ​增加​流式​、​命名​ Actor ​发现​和​直接​的​ Actor ​间通信​——​不​经过​ Ray ​的​对象​存储​。

docs.title: 独立​模式​：Pulsing ​原生​ API
docs.text: ​适合​新​项目​或​需要​ Pulsing ​完整​特性​的​场景​：

docs.title: API ​对照表​（Ray -> Pulsing）
docs.text: Ray Pulsing ray.init() await pul.init() ray.shutdown() await pul.shutdown() @ray.remote @pul.remote Actor.remote(args...) await Actor.spawn(args...) ray.get(actor.method.remote(args...)) await actor.method(args...) ray.get_actor(name) await Actor.resolve(name) ​或​ await pul.resolve(name)

docs.title: 最小​示例
docs.text:
Ray：

import ray

ray.init()

@ray.remote
class Counter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.value = 0
    def inc(self):
        self.value += 1
        return self.value

counter = Counter.remote()
print(ray.get(counter.inc.remote()))
ray.shutdown()

Pulsing：

import pulsing as pul

@pul.remote
class Counter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.value = 0
    def inc(self):
        self.value += 1
        return self.value

async def main():
    await pul.init()
    counter = await Counter.spawn(name="counter")
    print(await counter.inc())
    await pul.shutdown()

​关键​差异​：

​方面​ Ray Pulsing ​创建​ Actor Counter.remote() await Counter.spawn() — ​原生​ async ​调用​方法​ ray.get(counter.inc.remote()) await counter.inc() — ​直接​ await ​按名​获取​ ray.get_actor("counter") await Counter.resolve("counter") — ​带​类型​代理​ ​流式​ ​非​内置​ ​原生​ async for chunk in actor.stream() ​发现​ ​需要​ GCS ​内置​ gossip，​零​外部​依赖​

​心智​模型​一致​（​远程​类​、spawn、​方法​调用​）。Pulsing ​增加​了​原生​ async、​流式​和​自​包含​集群​能力​。

docs.title: 节点​ 1（​种子​）
docs.text:
import pulsing as pul

@pul.remote
class Worker:
    def process(self, data: str) -> str:
        return f"processed: {data}"

await pul.init(addr="0.0.0.0:8000")
await Worker.spawn(name="worker")

docs.title: 节点​ 2（​加入​ + ​解析​）
docs.text:
import pulsing as pul

await pul.init(addr="0.0.0.0:8001", seeds=["192.168.1.1:8000"])
worker = await Worker.resolve("worker")
result = await worker.process("hello")

docs.title: 说明
docs.text:
• ​优先​使用​ typed proxy：await pul.resolve(name, cls=Class) ​或​ await Class.resolve(name)。
  • ​若​只有​运行​时​名称​：proxy = await pul.resolve(name) ​即可​直接​调用​方法​（​无​类型​约束​）。

docs.title: Actor ​模式
docs.text: ​在​写​完​第一个​ Actor ​之后​常用​的​几种​写法​：​命名​ Actor、resolve，​以及​何时​用​ ask / tell。

docs.title: 命名​ Actor ​与​ resolve
docs.text:
​给​ Actor ​起​一个​ name，​其他​代码​（​本​进程​或​集群​内​）​可以​用​ resolve ​按名​查找​：

import pulsing as pul

@pul.remote
class Worker:
    def process(self, data: str) -> str:
        return f"processed: {data}"

async def main():
    await pul.init()
    # ​带​名字​ spawn，​可​通过​ resolve ​发现​
    await Worker.spawn(name="worker")
    # ​之后​（​或​另​一​节点​）：​按名​拿到​ proxy
    worker = await Worker.resolve("worker")
    result = await worker.process("hello")
    await pul.shutdown()

​匿名​ Actor（​不传​ name=）​只能​通过​ spawn() ​返回​的​ ActorRef ​访问​。

docs.title: Ask ​与​ tell
docs.text:
模式​ ​方法​ ​适用​场景​ ​请求​–​响应​ await ref.ask(msg) ​或​ await proxy.method() ​需要​返回值​。 ​发送​即​忘​ await ref.tell(msg) ​不​需要​回复​；​尽力而为​投递​。

​有​类型​ proxy ​时​，​方法​调用​相当于​ ask（​会​返回​结果​）。​只有​在​手头​是​ ActorRef ​且​不想​等待​回复​时​再​用​ tell。
